info.title: S-3D API
info.description: API dùng chung cho Web, App, Admin và Xưởng. Mọi câu trả lời có dạng `{ success, data, message?, messageCode? }`; lỗi có dạng `ApiErrorDto`.

expiresAt.description: When the access token stops working: refresh before then.

app.description: Which app is signing in: admin and workshop need a staff role with access to them.

locked.description: super_admin: always every permission, cannot be edited or removed.

password.description: Set by someone who manages accounts: the person's new password (empty: unchanged).

canManage.description: Whether the caller may add and edit staff.

Content-Type.description: Send it exactly: the upload link is signed for this type.

publicUrl.description: Where anyone can see a public file once uploaded; null for private files.

key.description: Keep it: what the product, return request… saves to point at the file.

uploadUrl.description: PUT the file's bytes here, before expiresAt.

purpose.description: What the file is for: decides who may upload it, its types and size.

fileName.description: The file's own name; only its extension is kept.

contentType.description: The type the file will be sent with (the browser's File.type).

size.description: Size in bytes, exactly as it will be sent.

expiresAt.description: null for public files (their link does not expire).

token.description: Pass as `auth: { token }` (or `?token=`) when opening the socket; usable once.

namespace.description: The socket.io namespace on the backend's origin.

app.description: The app the socket is for; "shop" when left out. Admin / workshop need access to that app.

messageCode.description: Stable code the apps branch on, e.g. AUTH.LOGIN.NOT_VERIFIED.
